title: Choose Poorup homepage motion
question: Pick one purposeful background treatment for the board-free Parlor Desk homepage. Nothing will be animated until you choose.

options.label: Night Drive Pass
options.lineage: one pixel vehicle crossing the skyline
options.thesis: Give the after-hours parlor a rare, quiet sign of life: one vehicle passes behind the skyline when home appears, then the scene settles.
options.viewport: A one-shot transform-only pass scales with the skyline at 1920 and 2560 without moving the entry desk or changing layout.
options.risk: A loop would become decoration, so it runs once per home entry and becomes parked/static under reduced motion.

options.label: Skyline Depth Shift
options.lineage: fine-pointer parallax behind a fixed desk
options.thesis: Let the skyline respond to the player’s pointer by a few pixels, adding physical depth while the actions stay locked and calm.
options.viewport: The offset is capped in pixels, so it remains restrained on both desktop targets and disappears on touch/keyboard.
options.risk: Pointer-follow can feel like a toy; it has no automatic motion and should remain an optional fine-pointer enhancement.

options.label: Window Signal Relay
options.lineage: skyline windows echo a connection event
options.thesis: When the client becomes online again, a handful of windows light in a short deterministic relay, making the connection state feel present without replacing the status text.
options.viewport: The same SVG window coordinates scale with the skyline, so the relay stays aligned at both target sizes.
options.risk: It must remain event-driven; random or infinite flicker would undermine trust and accessibility.

options.label: CRT Horizon Sweep
options.lineage: one scan across the skyline on arrival
options.thesis: Use a single 700–900ms horizon sweep when Home first appears or Profile returns, then let the parlor settle.
options.viewport: A clipped transform/opacity sweep stays inside the skyline layer and never changes page geometry.
options.risk: Without a state transition to explain, it is mostly polish; it should not be replayed on every interaction.

canonCard.label: Keep the homepage still
canonCard.thesis: Ship the current quiet skyline with no new motion if none of the concepts earns its place.
canonCard.viewport: The board-free Parlor Desk remains exactly as it is at both desktop targets.
canonCard.risk: The page stays calm but gives up the small sense of life requested for the after-hours setting.
